  dates considered                  : 2

REFUSING TO EMIT A SKILL CONSTANT: only 0 games carry a projection (< --min-games 30).
0 games joined to a final, but a joined game the model never
scored says nothing about the model. Gating on the join instead of on
the projection is how a 9-game sample gets reported as 361.

THE FINDING IS THE COVERAGE, NOT THE SKILL: production game_cards carry
a projection on 0 of 0 completed games. Fix that
before measuring skill -- a correlation here would be #377 again.
